column4: frontier (inherent) — triage is a frontier task by this repo's own policy: the router has to be smarter than the routed, and a cheaper model classifying work it may later be handed is the conflict of interest the taxonomy exists to prevent. Not a spec gap; the requirement is structural.

standard — deterministic static analysis with loud failures (wrong recommendations are visible in output); no risk surface touched, no silent failure mode, existing pattern to copy (MetaHarness analyze-repo).
frontier (spec) — issue describes the problem but does not pick a versioning approach; "Needs an ADR" is the spec gap. Specifying the scheme would make stamping and drift-detection wiring mechanical.

frontier (inherent) — research quality is a silent failure (shallow analysis reads as thorough); requires holding multiple constraints (cost, auth model, migration path) simultaneously with no mechanical verification.
